title: UniProt: the Universal Protein Knowledgebase in 2025
funder: National Human Genome Research Institute [HG002273]; NIH Office of the Director [U24HG007822]; NIAID; NIA; NIGMS [R35GM141873]; NIDDK; NEI; NCI; NHLBI; BBSRC [BB/T015608/1]; National Science Foundation Directorate for Biological Sciences [BB/X002179/1]; Open Targets; Horizon 2020 [825575]; Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation; EMBL Australia.
result: Reviewed human UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03 (2 September 2026), read through rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-22. COX10 (Q12887): heme O synthase, converts protoheme IX and farnesyl diphosphate to heme O; mitochondrial membrane; variants cause mitochondrial complex IV deficiency, nuclear type 3. COX15 (Q7KZN9): heme A synthase, converts heme O to heme A, the prosthetic group of cytochrome c oxidase; inner mitochondrial membrane; predominantly in tissues with high oxidative phosphorylation, including muscle, heart and brain; variants cause complex IV deficiency, nuclear type 6. TRIT1 (Q9H3H1): transfers a dimethylallyl group from dimethylallyl diphosphate to adenine 37 of a subset of cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNAs, with partial modification of the selenocysteine tRNA, and is required for selenoprotein expression; variants cause combined oxidative phosphorylation deficiency 35. COQ2 (Q96H96): prenylates 4-hydroxybenzoate with the decaprenyl chain to form coenzyme Q10, which carries electrons between respiratory chain complexes; highest expression in skeletal muscle, adrenal glands and heart; variants cause primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency 1. DHDDS (Q86SQ9): with NUS1 condenses isopentenyl diphosphate onto farnesyl diphosphate to form the precursor of dolichol phosphate, the sugar carrier for protein glycosylation in the endoplasmic reticulum; variants cause congenital disorder of glycosylation 1BB and retinitis pigmentosa 59. HMGCR (P04035): rate-limiting step in the synthesis of cholesterol and other isoprenoids; main target of statins; highest expression in cerebellum, fetal brain, testis, skin and adrenal gland; biallelic variants cause autosomal recessive limb-girdle muscular dystrophy 28, with progressive proximal and axial weakness, limited ambulation or wheelchair dependence within a few decades and frequent respiratory insufficiency (PubMed 36745799, 37167966).
